_nota: El material fotografico de la pelicula del ecosistema. Tres versiones dibujadas por codigo se quedaron en 'super sencillo, nada espectacular' -Jose- y en 'existe lo minimalista y existe lo pobre; esto es pobre' -un director creativo-. La causa no era el grano ni las curvas: era que un video 100% vectorial sobre negro no tiene PESO por bien que se anime. Lo caro es material real con luz real y la tipografia encima, minima. Se invierte la proporcion: 80% imagen fotografica generada, 20% graficos compuestos encima.
_regla: Cada plano describe MATERIA y LUZ, nunca conceptos. Oro, cristal, piel, piedra, metal cepillado. Una sola fuente dura desde arriba a la izquierda, negro absoluto detras, macro con poca profundidad de campo. Todo lento y deliberado: la camara casi no se mueve, se mueve la luz o el objeto. Ninguna pantalla lleva contenido -se compone despues-, ningun logo se genera -se compone despues-. Es la unica forma de que doce planos parezcan rodados el mismo dia en el mismo estudio.

defaults.negative: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, plastic, low poly, oversaturated, flat lighting, daylight, window, room, clutter, background objects, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, ui elements, phone screen content, readable screen, faces smiling, stock photo, motion blur smear, morphing, blurry, low detail, scratches on lens

shots.still: Extreme macro photograph of the surface of a raw gold nugget filling the entire frame, deep pits and crystalline ridges in the metal, a single hard light from the upper left raking across it so every ridge throws a shadow and every facet catches a hot specular highlight, the pits falling into pure black. Pure black void beyond the edges of the metal. Studio product macro, very shallow depth of field, focus on the central ridge Faint haze in the air and a few motes of dust drifting through the light beam, so the light itself is visible.
shots.motion: the light source drifts slowly from left to right, so the hot highlights slide across the ridges and the shadows in the pits swing with them

shots.still: Extreme macro of fine gold dust and tiny gold flakes falling slowly through a narrow beam of hard light in a pure black void, each flake flashing as it turns through the beam, the ones outside the beam invisible. Very shallow depth of field so most flakes are soft orbs of light and only a few in the focal plane are sharp. Studio product macro, black background, nothing else in frame Faint haze in the air and a few motes of dust drifting through the light beam, so the light itself is visible.
shots.motion: the flakes drift downward in slow motion, tumbling, each one flashing once as it crosses the beam and going dark below it

shots.still: Extreme macro of the surface of molten gold in a dark crucible, filling the frame, a thick liquid metal skin with high surface tension, viscous like mercury, heavy liquid physics, with a slow ripple moving across it, the ripple crest catching a hard rim light while the troughs go deep amber and then black. Pure black void around the crucible edge. Studio macro, very shallow depth of field, the heat shimmer barely visible
shots.motion: one slow ripple crosses the surface from bottom left to top right, the highlight sliding along its crest, and the surface settles behind it

shots.still: A matte black smartphone lying on a slab of dark polished slate in a pure black studio, photographed from a low three-quarter angle, macro, a single hard light from the upper left drawing one clean edge highlight along the phone's aluminium frame and a soft reflection of the phone in the slate. The screen is on and throws a soft even warm gold-tinted glow onto the slate, the same amber as molten metal, its content out of focus and illegible. Nothing else in frame
shots.motion: the screen brightens from dark to lit over two seconds and its glow spreads across the slate, the reflection brightening with it

shots.still: Extreme macro of a single fingertip pressing onto the glass of a phone screen, the skin flattening and going pale against the glass, the fine ridges of the fingerprint visible, the glass lit from beneath by the screen's soft glow with its content out of focus and illegible, a reflection of the fingertip in the glass. Olive skin. Pure black void around. Studio macro, razor-thin depth of field on the point of contact
shots.motion: the fingertip presses down, the skin flattens and the reflection meets it, holds, then lifts away leaving a faint print

shots.still: A single open hand, palm up, entering a shaft of hard light from below in a pure black void, olive weathered skin with hyper-detailed micro-texture and visible lines in the palm, the hand muscles tensing slightly as if taking weight, the light catching the fingertips first and then the palm, the back of the hand and the wrist falling into black. Nothing in the hand. Studio macro, shallow depth of field on the palm, black background Faint haze in the air and a few motes of dust drifting through the light beam, so the light itself is visible.
shots.motion: the hand rises slowly into the light, opens a little more, and holds still with the fingers slightly curled as if something has just landed in it

shots.still: Extreme macro of a plain matte black payment card sliding into the slot of a dark card terminal, the card's EMV chip catching a hard gold-tinted light from the upper left, the brushed metal of the slot edge drawing one clean highlight, everything else in pure black. No text or logos on the card. Studio product macro, very shallow depth of field on the chip
shots.motion: the card slides in slowly and seats with a small settle, the highlight on the chip sliding along it as it enters

shots.still: Two hands meeting in a shaft of hard light in a pure black void: one hand, older with weathered brown skin, passing a matte black phone to a younger hand with olive skin, the phone between them catching one edge highlight, both wrists falling into black. Screen off. Studio macro, shallow depth of field on the phone, black background, nothing else in frame Faint haze in the air and a few motes of dust drifting through the light beam, so the light itself is visible.
shots.motion: the older hand extends the phone, the younger hand closes around it, and for a moment both hold it together before the older hand lets go

shots.still: Close up of a 31 year old Central American woman's face in a pure black void, lit only from below by the soft glow of a phone screen held out of frame, the light catching her cheekbones, the underside of her brow and the wet of her eyes, everything else black. Olive skin with real texture and pores. Mouth closed, expression calm and attentive, looking down at the screen. Studio portrait, shallow depth of field Faint haze in the air and a few motes of dust drifting through the light beam, so the light itself is visible.
shots.motion: her eyes track across the screen once, she blinks slowly, and the glow on her face brightens a little as if something has just appeared

shots.still: A single thin thread of warm golden light travelling through a pure black void thick with faint haze, the thread sharp at its leading point with a soft anamorphic lens flare, the light interacting with microscopic dust suspended in the air so its path is visible as a glowing corridor, a faint reflection on an unseen dark glass surface below. Abstract, no objects, no text. Studio macro, black background, the thread the only thing in frame
shots.motion: the leading point of light travels steadily from the bottom left to the upper right of the frame, leaving the softening trail behind it

shots.still: Extreme macro of a droplet of liquid gold resting on a sheet of dark glass in a pure black void, the droplet a perfect bead with a hard specular highlight from the upper left and a warm reflection in the glass beneath it, the glass edge catching one thin line of light. Studio product macro, razor-thin depth of field on the droplet, nothing else in frame
shots.motion: the droplet trembles once very slightly, the highlight wobbling and settling, and then it is perfectly still

shots.still: A raw gold nugget resting alone on a slab of dark polished slate in a pure black studio, photographed from slightly above, a single hard light from the upper left drawing a hot highlight along its top ridge and a soft warm reflection in the slate, the far side of the nugget falling into black. Nothing else in frame. Studio product shot, shallow depth of field on the nugget Faint haze in the air and a few motes of dust drifting through the light beam, so the light itself is visible.
shots.motion: the light source settles and holds, the highlight on the ridge steadying, the nugget perfectly still
